fields.primary_image: site-relative path to rights-cleared primary presentation image
fields.rights_basis: documented publication basis: original-photography | licensed | manufacturer-press-media | manufacturer-editorial-use | open-license | public-domain; manufacturer-editorial-use also requires editorial_purpose. GlassesResearch redistribution
fields.try_on_asset: optional transparent front-facing asset suitable for face overlay
fields.try_on_scale: Per-model overlay width multiplier relative to detected outer-eye distance; numeric, 1.0–4.0.
fields.try_on_y_offset: Per-model vertical overlay offset in percentage points; numeric.
fields.try_on_rotation_offset: Per-model rotation correction in degrees; numeric.

publication_gate: A visual record may be state=published only when primary_image, source_url or original-photography provenance, credit, rights_basis, retrieval/capture date, and alt text are documented. try_on_asset additionally requires a model-specific transparent asset; visual try-on is not a fit measurement.
